gloss: to be on good terms; to be close; to get along well

definitions.gloss: to be on good terms; to be close friends; to get along well
definitions.explanation: Describes a relationship where two or more people have a warm, friendly connection and enjoy each other's company.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{仲|なか}が{良|よ}い。
examples.english: Those two are on good terms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{仲|なか}が{良|よ}くて、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦バーベキュー→バーベキュー：27519_baabekyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We get along well with the family next door and often have barbecues together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仲|なか}が{良|よ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧うれしいことだ。
examples.english: It makes parents happy when siblings get along well.

notes:
A fundamental expression for describing interpersonal relationships. Often written as ⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ in casual contexts. The opposite is ⟦{仲|なか}が{悪|わる}い→仲が悪い：25621_nakagawarui⟧ (to be on bad terms).

USAGE:
Often modifies nouns: ⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧ (a close friend). Can also be used predicatively: {仲|なか}が{良|よ}い (they get along well). The colloquial form uses ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ instead of ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧: a close friend
- ⟦{仲|なか}{良|よ}くする→仲良くする：25567_nakayokusuru⟧: to get along with, to be friendly
- ⟦{仲|なか}{良|よ}く→仲良い：29434_nakayoi⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧: to live harmoniously
- {仲|なか}が{良|よ}さそう: they seem to get along well

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{親|した}しい→親しい：02345_shitashii⟧: close, intimate — describes the depth of a relationship
- ⟦{気|き}が{合|あ}う→気が合う：22839_kigaau⟧: to hit it off — emphasizes compatibility
- ⟦{仲|なか}が{悪|わる}い→仲が悪い：25621_nakagawarui⟧: to be on bad terms — the opposite expression
